# CopyButton

Copies a tracklist, ID, ISRC, link or file path to the clipboard, swaps its icon to a check for 2 seconds and announces "Copied"; when the browser refuses, it…

`SongNodes.CopyButton` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.CopyButton value="…" what="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.CopyButton" value="…" what="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (CopyButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` * | `string` | Text placed on the clipboard. |
| `what` * | `string` | What is copied, for the label and the announcement ("Tracklist", "ISRC"). |
| `label` | `string` | Visible label ("Copy tracklist"); omit with iconOnly. |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | Icon-only button (aria-label "Copy <what>"). |
| `showValue` | `{ name: string }` | Show the value itself beside the button, with its source name ("Spotify ID"). |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` | Button size. |
| `confirmMs` | `number` | Milliseconds the check icon and "Copied" stay; default 2000. |
| `onCopied` | `() => void` | Called after a successful copy. |
| `onFallback` | `() => void` | Called when every clipboard method is refused and the select-the-text fallback is shown. |
